final: SELECT (SELECT AVG(m) FROM (SELECT AVG(product_price) AS m FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number HAVING COUNT(product_price) > 0)) AS avg_of_mean_price, (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoices) FROM Invoice_Line_Items WHERE invoice_number IN (SELECT invoice_number FROM Invoices)) AS avg_line_items_per_invoice
